definition: This dimension controls how risky it is to use unidentified items, varying from benign effects to severe consequences. It encompasses the potential outcomes of using unknown items and the likelihood of negative repercussions.
exclusion_criteria: Items that have no consequences when used unidentified
Systems where all items are identified prior to use
inclusion_criteria: The potential for harmful effects from unidentified items
The probability of beneficial effects from unidentified items
title: Risk of Use Variability
